after disagreement between the original blocking finding and an independent
approval. This qualifies as the rare contested-finding exception; no routine
repair or full review loop is being restarted.

5236849687 on55e57394 and PR507 body/history using PRIMARY gh_common.py.
The new reviewer approved with zero unchecked findings but explicitly says
unchanged member refs are no-ops excluded from the server transaction and
the residual advertisement-to-commit window is not closed. MAIN posted an
operator hold, local-review/summary=failure, comment5716048218. That is an
unresolved contract question, not authority to invent a stronger contract.
The original F1 requested exact-member publication protection and a
transport-start race test. F2 concerned canonical telemetry writer/lock;
that has reportedly been fixed. Preserve all prior rounds/costs/approvals.

Determine precisely what issue502, the original accepted design and trusted
policy require at publication. Then determine what checked-push.sh and the
candidate train tool actually guarantee. Candidate policy text cannot alone
weaken the original requirement. A transport-start ref mutation is different
from a server ref mutation after advertisement and before transaction commit.
Reproduce the latter in a minimal isolated local bare-remote fixture if that
is necessary to distinguish the claims, using the candidate guarded push
path, private cache/telemetry paths, no live remote, no network dependency.
For example a receive hook or controlled transport barrier can create the
timing, but do not assume a particular fixture demonstrates the race until
the observed ref sequence supports it. Use an existing focused test where
possible; do not build new infrastructure or change the production branch.

Deliver one concrete disposition: original F1 satisfied and operator hold
may be removed, genuine remaining in-scope blocker with the smallest remedy,
or an owner-only scope decision with concrete reviewable options. Explain
the invariant and evidence, reproducible commands/logs/ref values, actual
limits and whether the docstring overclaims. Do not request new train
features, require speculative hardening, or silently waive an original
blocker. If no enforceable client-only remedy exists on the actual server,
say so and distinguish a narrowly worded contract from an implementation
fix; MAIN handles the decision and any repair assignment.

Return /tmp/pr507-publication-adjudication-20260917-report.md and a hash
manifest, with exact reviewed head/trusted pin, prior-finding disposition,
checks and their limits. This is a technical adjudication packet, not a new
full PR review and not a posted approval. Do not append a misleading review
marker/VERDICT to a report whose decision needs an owner ruling.

Budget600 seconds including final120 for reproducible evidence and report;
absolute UTC deadline supplied at spawn. Stop with truthful evidence at
deadline; no new attempt or silent scope expansion. One task, then retire.
